edges = []
n = 15
for i in range(n):
    u = i
    v = (i + 1) % n
    if u < v:
        edges.append((u, v))
    else:
        edges.append((v, u))

# Remove duplicates and sort
edges = sorted(list(set(edges)))

# Verify degrees

    degrees[u] += 1
    degrees[v] += 1
